observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show an outdoor yard with stacks of blue cylindrical drums, some green drums in the background, and large white IBC tanks.
The blue drums are stacked vertically, with their circular ends visible; they appear to be made of plastic or fiberglass.
The white tanks are standard IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) tanks, with visible plastic frames and metal corner protectors.
The ground is muddy and unpaved; the setting appears to be a storage or sales yard.
Text overlay 'OLOKUTA PROPERTY MART' is present in both photos, likely added by the seller.
No visible brand names, model numbers, or capacity markings on the blue drums or white tanks.
No signs of damage or wear are clearly visible on the drums or tanks from these angles.
